description: This file is a PHP script that includes HTML and JavaScript to provide a web interface for resetting and restoring a network gateway device. It contains UI elements, scripts for user interactions, confirmation dialogs, and AJAX calls to perform reset and restore operations on the device.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Prepares and sends an AJAX request to initiate a reset or restore operation based on user interaction, handling UI feedback and triggering device reboot or Wi-Fi restart.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Periodically checks if the device has rebooted by sending a GET request to the index page, then redirects to login upon success.
